These projects start from the data rather than a practitioner’s brief, so the question is about method: which approach fits the data, and why. Each one goes all the way through, comparing methods and models, fitting and checking the chosen one, and turning the output into something a non-specialist can use. Code is linked from each project.

::: {#research-list}
:::
